title: Eleanor Oliphant Is Completely Fine
author: Gail Honeyman
summary: An office worker in Glasgow lives by strict routines, speaks with blunt precision and sees nobody outside work. A small act of kindness from a colleague begins to pull her out of that tightly controlled life.
readIf: you like narrators who are funny without meaning to be, and recovery stories that take their time.
skipIf: you want to avoid a story built around childhood trauma and loneliness, even though it ends warmly.

pairings.reason: Another short, deadpan novel about a woman who does not fit social expectations and handles it in her own way.
Pairs the same prickly outer shell with a soft, aching inside, and a similarly gradual rescue by neighbours.
A much lighter romantic comedy with a hero who is also a literal, rule-driven outsider.
